query:
SELECT
            pv.mod_id,
            pv.amount,
            m.name AS "project_name?",
            m.slug AS "project_slug?"
        FROM payouts_values pv
        LEFT JOIN mods m ON m.id = pv.mod_id
        WHERE pv.user_id = $1
          AND pv.date_available <= NOW()
          AND pv.amount > 0
        ORDER BY pv.date_available, pv.created, pv.id
